description: If the original language has countably many symbols, a second-order sentence follows in every general model exactly when it is derivable in the specified translated first-order calculus.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinSemantics.completeness.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language} [Countable L.Symbols]
  (T : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinSemantics.Theory L)
  (φ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinSemantics.Sentence L) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinSemantics.Models T φ ↔ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinSemantics.Derives T φ
